journey.name: TL-04 Un-completing a task clears the strikethrough
journey.description:
Covers the other direction of FR-03, starting from the one seed row that arrives completed: "Book dentist" (SeedData.kt:50-55). Its checkbox is described as "Mark incomplete", because the label names the action the tap performs (issue #9). An edit to a completed task must not silently un-complete it and un-completing must not lose the other fields.
Preconditions: adb shell am force-stop com.rounds.test.to_dolist adb shell am start -n com.rounds.test.to_dolist/.MainActivity --es qa_failure_rate 0.0

actions.action: Verify that the "Book dentist" row has a checked checkbox
Verify that the "Book dentist" title is struck through
Tap the checkbox with the content description "Mark incomplete" on the "Book dentist" row
Verify that the "Book dentist" row now has an unchecked checkbox
Verify that the "Book dentist" title is not struck through
Verify that the "Book dentist" row still has an element with the content description "Low"
